how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-unknown-12-r2.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:78090:title: A Second Opinion
rows.quest:78090:details:0:
I'm not sure what to make of this orb, ⟦1⟧ . I think we will need the help of... a specialist.

We are aware of a warlock sect operating out of ⟦E1⟧. Officially we reject the presence of warlocks in the city. Unofficially, their knowledge can be of use when dealing with demonic forces.

Find a representative of these warlocks, and seek their opinion on the orb.
rows.quest:78090:progress:0: You're a long way from the cathedral, ⟦2⟧ . I hope you realize you have no authority here.
rows.quest:78090:completion:0: So the Silver Hand requires my aid? It will not come cheaply.
rows.quest:78091:title: Earning Your ⟦E3⟧
rows.quest:78091:details:0:
I will study the orb and tell you what I learn, but you must first do something for me.

The warlocks of the Blackrock clan use specially prepared salts to enhance their summoning rituals. Collect some from the orcs in Redridge.

When you return, I will share with you the results of my studies.
rows.quest:78091:completion:0: Ah... the salts. I had forgotten all about them. ⟦3⟧ This orb is unlike anything I have seen, ⟦4⟧ .
rows.quest:78092:title: It Must Be Destroyed
rows.quest:78092:details:0:
This orb is indeed connected to a powerful entity, somewhere beyond the ⟦E4⟧. I cannot divine its nature, but I feel its perception reaching through the orb... studying me in return.

I am reluctant to admit this, ⟦5⟧ , but the orb must be destroyed.

It seems impervious to most damage, but it may be vulnerable to the weapon of a powerful demon lord. I am unsure where you will find such a weapon, but it remains your best option.

Good luck, ⟦6⟧ .
rows.quest:78093:title: Return to Delgren
rows.quest:78093:details:0: <The shattered remains of the orb lay at your feet. Delgren will want to see you have succeeded.>
rows.quest:78093:progress:0: Did you find a way to destroy the orb?
rows.quest:78093:completion:0: This is a relief, ⟦7⟧ . But whatever was watching ⟦E7⟧ through that orb... I have a feeling they will not be happy it was destroyed. ⟦8⟧ Take this as my thanks for your efforts. And... be careful.
rows.quest:79007:title: ... and that note you found
rows.quest:79007:obj:0: Charred remains of the note serve as your only guide.

rows.quest:6701:title: ⟦E19⟧ Emblems
rows.quest:6701:progress:0: We have been entrenched in a battle with the ⟦E19⟧ for years. What they lack in skill they make up for in numbers. It's impossible to kill them off fast enough to have any noticeable impact on their population!⟦12⟧⟦13⟧We've found that the best way to deal with their size is to pilfer their emblems. Once an emblem is stolen the shamed member is 'dealt' with internally.⟦14⟧⟦15⟧Pick their pockets clean and turn the emblems in to me or one of the other guards.⟦16⟧⟦17⟧Start at Durnholde, south of here.
rows.quest:6701:completion:0: Hey, nice work! Keep this up and the other rogues might stop spitting on you.
rows.quest:79192:title: Stepping Stones
rows.quest:79192:details:0: The note begins, "Mission said they were both making deliveries for New Plague. Looks like simple apothecary accidents to me. Find my cozy spot in the mountains between ⟦E21⟧ and ⟦E22⟧ if you want a safe place to talk."
rows.quest:79192:completion:0: Backcountry adventurers and mercenaries alike undoubtedly make camp here. The corner of a note flapping in the breeze catches your eye and you reach for it.
rows.quest:95663:title: Dragonmaw Rumors
rows.quest:95663:obj:0: ⟦E23⟧ to the ⟦E24⟧ and meet the Deathstalker Agent in the hills above the Dragonmaw camp.
rows.quest:95663:details:0: The Dragonmaw are a formidable clan.
rows.quest:95663:details:1: They're known for binding magic strong enough to make dragons serve, and rumor claims they're preparing some display of it in the ⟦E24⟧. Whether truth or bluster, the Deathstalkers can't act on half-formed whispers. Broken symbols carried only that much to me.
rows.quest:95663:details:2: A deathstalker agent needs a hand in the hills above the Dragonmaw encampment. Meet her there. She'll reveal the next steps.
rows.quest:95664:title: Elder Knowledge
rows.quest:95664:obj:0: Take the ⟦E25⟧ to the Elder Rise in ⟦E26⟧ and look for someone who can tell you more about it.
rows.quest:95664:details:0: This unusual composite shard scatters light like a living prism. Its nature is uncertain, but its power feels ancient. The most knowledgeable minds for artifacts of this bygone age must reside on the Elder rise in ⟦E26⟧.
rows.quest:95664:progress:0: Spirits honor you. Have you come to share with us?
rows.quest:95682:title: Open the Maw
rows.quest:95682:obj:0: Slay the Dragonmaw forces within the Excavation Site and return to the Deathstalker Agent outside with anything you recover.
rows.quest:95682:details:1: The remnants of the dragon-wrangling clan think they've found something that could lead to them rising to their former power. In the eyes of whom... their false warchief?
rows.quest:95682:details:2: Clear out their ragtag clan within the Excavation Sites so our Deathstalkers can move in undetected.
rows.quest:95682:details:3: If the Dragonmaw carry anything of note upon them, return it to me--this information must stay between us and our royal command.
rows.quest:95682:progress:0: We're here to get the important job done. If you can help, prove it.
rows.quest:95737:title: Seeking Caitlin
rows.quest:95772:title: Songblade Search
rows.quest:95772:obj:0: Look for Dorin Songblade's brother, Daewyn, in Whelgar's Excavation Site.
rows.quest:95772:details:0: Me brother tried draggin' me off tae the ⟦E24⟧ with some diggin' crew out o' ⟦E28⟧. Said they were headin' into hills no dwarf's ever set boot in for some sort o' excavation.
rows.quest:95772:details:1: Aye, I'd 'ave gone, if I wasn't already behind on this pile o' girdles I've got to refit.
rows.quest:95772:details:2: Daewyn normally writes after he sends off, though. Haven't heard a thing, gives me a strange feelin' this time.
rows.quest:95772:details:3: If yer marchin' that way, mind checking in on me brother?
rows.quest:95795:title: Fallen in the Fen
rows.quest:95795:details:0: ⟦E23⟧ to Lakeshire and personally inform Dorin Songblade what became of his brother within the Excavation Sites.
rows.quest:95809:title: Heartwoven
rows.quest:95809:details:0: I need a moment to rest before I find my own way out.
rows.quest:95809:details:1: Take this, and bring it back to Caitlin. Let her know I'll be home soon! Now that we have a path cleared out thanks to you, I'll gather my bushels and follow your trail.
rows.quest:95809:progress:0: I'm more than worried about him!
rows.quest:95810:title: Lost Relic Carry
rows.quest:95810:obj:0: Bring the ⟦E25⟧ to ⟦E33⟧ in the ⟦E24⟧ excavation site.
rows.quest:95810:details:0: You pick up a fractured piece of the rock-mech automaton. It has a texture unlike anything you've touched before, a composite material of unknown makeup. This is certainly bound to be more 'device' than 'debris.'
rows.quest:95810:details:1: ⟦E33⟧ himself at his excavation site might have something useful to share about the relic.
